title: 추락 직전
suno_analysis_sp: K-Indie rock track featuring a clean electric guitar playing a rhythmic, syncopated chord pattern. A warm, melodic bass guitar follows the kick drum pattern. The drums consist of a tight snare and a steady kick with occasional hi-hat accents. Male vocals are delivered in a smooth, conversational baritone with light reverb. The arrangement is sparse, focusing on the interplay between the vocal melody and the rhythmic guitar strumming. Key of E Major, 85 BPM.
suno_analysis_lyrics:
